snippet.title: Meander Forth Chapter 0+1+2 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Meander Forth Chapter 2 will be available to the public on September 19th, 2025, just in time for SAGE 2025. The is the first time Chapter 2 has been playable (outside of Patreon builds, wink wink nudge nudge) as well as the first time Meander Forth's Godot build will be present at SAGE. 

Song: Blue 60 by Dogs++

Play it here: (When it's ready)
SFGHQ: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/meander-forth-chapter-0-1-2-demo.2545/
Itch: https://whiskerfjords.itch.io/meander-forth-demo
